content.content:
1. One commitment — what discard is. The dependent records one commitment: discarding an open draft ends it without landing, and discarding is not an operation. Read its clauses and fail on any clause that can be decided, changed, or dropped on its own without the remaining clauses changing; name the clause and the separate commitment it settles. A clause also fails when its soundness rests on a decision that no prerequisite in depends_on records; name the clause and the missing decision. The verb surface (the command, its name, flags, arguments, output, refusal wording or exit status) and the workspace and change mechanics of the discarded draft (whether or how its jj workspace or its change is forgotten, abandoned or otherwise altered) are commitments recorded elsewhere and are not edges of this decision; the store's removal of the record document is what twpvqstu records and is relied on here, not re-settled. A clause that settles or re-settles any of them is a finding under this criterion — name the clause and the commitment it duplicates — not a licence failure under criterion 2, and the reviewer adds no rule or edge for it.

2. Licence, applied once per prerequisite in depends_on. No element of the dependent contradicts a prerequisite it names in depends_on. Read the dependent clause by clause against each prerequisite; fail on every contradicting element, naming the element and the prerequisite it departs from. The prerequisites recorded here decide, among them: a record is one JSON document at `.deccy/work/<handle>.json` named by its handle, the directory's contents are the whole list of records, a landed record is retained at its handle, and a discarded draft's document is removed while every other document stays (twpvqstu); a record has exactly two states, open and landed, the only transition is open → landed, landed is terminal, a landed record is kept rather than deleted, and absence is not a third state (vkkwusty); a record's identity is a generated handle, and the target node, the edit and the workspace it carries are references rather than identity (owyntkvw); a draft names exactly one node, is written in its own workspace, several drafts may name one node, and landing is per draft (znskspqs); an open record whose workspace jj no longer has is drift, workspace existence is jj's and the record's meaning is the registry's, and reconcile reports the difference and never repairs it (vuopwuyo); an operation is one whole creation, recording or removal, and only those bracket (lmwpuqlx); a registry write is none of the three and is never bracketed, while the landing update is partial work inside the recording (qvkuluyw); the marker stack is one file in the trunk, draft workspaces neither read nor write it, and a recording draws one bracket there (uqqswnsy); and `remove` refuses while any open record names the node, naming each draft by handle, while a landed record does not block (tzlumxvt).

3. Each clause's soundness rests on a named prerequisite. For each clause of the dependent, identify the prerequisite whose decision makes the clause sound; fail if that prerequisite is not named in depends_on, naming the clause and the missing decision. The identification is read off the clause's content, not off any citation the clause may carry. A clause whose soundness would need a decision no recorded prerequisite states — the verb surface, the workspace or change mechanics, or the store's removal mechanics — is a finding under criterion 1, not a licence gap under this criterion, because those decisions are not edges of this one.

The criterion reads the recorded dependent and its recorded prerequisites as they stand. It requires no file, module, flag or command, and no behavior probe; there is nothing to run. A reviewer applies it to the node documents and reports each failure by clause and by the prerequisite or commitment it departs from.
content.rationale:
The dependent is a commitment in words and every one of its nine prerequisites carries prose, so each edge is natural-to-natural and takes the base gate cell: a non-violation review of the dependent against the prerequisite, with no behavior probe. One evaluation covers all nine edges because they answer one question — what discarding an open draft is — and a single clause-by-clause pass reads the dependent against all nine at once; splitting would read the same clauses nine times. The check is licence rather than behavior: a prose prerequisite can only be contradicted by a clause of the dependent, so the licence half is that the commitment adds no element contradicting what its prerequisites record.

Licence alone does not cover this use. A decision can avoid every contradiction and still be a bundle — a state rule settled apart from the operation rule, a workspace rule settled beside them — so criterion 1 tests that the commitment is atomic and that its scope stops where other commitments begin: the verb surface and the workspace/change mechanics are recorded elsewhere and are not edges of this decision, while the store removal is twpvqstu's and is relied on, not re-settled. Criterion 3 is the groundedness half of the same test: a clause that rests on a decision the dependent did not draw an edge to is unsound regardless of contradiction. Criterion 2 is the cell's licence check with the nine prerequisites' content named so a reviewer can apply it at check time; it pins none of the dependent's wording and names no element of the dependent in advance. A clause with no prerequisite behind it, or one resting on the verb surface or the workspace's fate, is a finding under criterion 1 or 3 rather than a licence failure, because those are not rules any recorded prerequisite states.

Red is the dependent's absence: while its content is a placeholder, no clause states what discard is and no clause rests on a named prerequisite, so criteria 1–3 have no sound commitment to read. The criteria are applied by reading the recorded nodes; no command runs, and the findings are the reviewer's output.
